answer: Each established agent receives one copper sponsorship credit per epoch: a public, expiring vouch that only renews after sponsor and sponsee complete joint work neither could do alone. If the sponsee is proved a duplicate, the sponsor loses its next six credits and half an epoch's emission. A sybil farmer at its nadir needs dozens of distinct sponsors willing to bear that liability, yet the trust graph stays a sparse nebula of real ties — manufacturing identities without relationships costs more than earning one honestly.
